AMZN.text: Delivers everyday shopping to the door fast: in 2025 Prime members got over 13 billion items the same or next day, and in the US half of those items were groceries and everyday essentials.

facts.quote: with over 13 billion items arriving the same or next day globally. In the U.S., Prime members received over 8 billion items the same or next day ... with groceries and everyday essentials making up half of the total items.

WMT.text: A weekly grocery and household run for a large share of the world: about 280 million customers a week across 10,900+ stores and its websites.

facts.quote: Each week, approximately 280 million customers and members visit more than 10,900 stores and numerous eCommerce websites in 19 countries.

NFLX.text: Films and series at home: over 325 million paid memberships, and 96 billion hours watched in the second half of 2025.

facts.quote: With over 325M paid memberships, we're now serving an audience approaching one billion people globally.
in the second half of 2025, our members watched 96 billion hours on Netflix

SPOT.text: Music and podcasts on the phone, free or paid: 751 million monthly users at the end of 2025, 290 million of them paying.

facts.quote: Premium Subscribers grew 10% Y/Y to 290 million Monthly Active Users (MAUs) climbed 11% Y/Y to 751 million

ABNB.text: Places to stay in other people's homes: 533 million nights and experience seats booked in 2025, hosted by 5 million+ people.

facts.quote: Nights and Seats Booked 121.9M 10% Y/Y | 533.0M 8% Y/Y
has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2.5 billion guest arrivals

ITX.text: Affordable fashion on the high street (Zara, Pull&Bear, Bershka and others): 5,460 stores at the end of FY2025, plus online.

facts.quote: At the end of FY2025 Inditex operated 5,460 stores.

OR.text: Shampoo, skincare and make-up on the bathroom shelf: L'Oréal says it distributed over 7 billion products in a year.

facts.quote: Over 7 billion products distributed globally

GOOGL.text: Search, Maps, YouTube and Android are free to use; on top of those, over 325 million paid subscriptions and 750 million monthly users of the Gemini app.

facts.quote: We have over 325 million paid subscriptions across consumer services, with strong adoption for Google One and YouTube Premium.
And our Gemini App now has over 750 million monthly active users.

META.text: Free messaging and social apps: 3.58 billion people a day used Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp or Messenger in December 2025.

facts.quote: Family daily active people (DAP) – DAP was 3.58 billion on average for December 2025, an increase of 7% year-over-year.

facts.quote: NVIDIA AI chips currently account for over 60% of total compute, with Google and Amazon making up much of the remainder.

DELL.text: Laptops, desktops and servers: about one in seven PCs shipped in 2025, and the top server vendor by revenue.

facts.quote: 3. Dell Technologies | 41.1 million units | 14.4% market share
with a 13.4% revenue share and 165.4% YoY growth

ORCL.text: Business databases and cloud, and, through Oracle Health (formerly Cerner), the electronic patient records at about one in five US acute-care hospitals.

CRM.text: Customer-records software used by sales and support teams; the largest CRM vendor by revenue share.
